jobs.description:
We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months and now serve 10,000+ customers.

Fonio is Europe's market leader for AI phone agents for SMBs. Now were expanding globally and into new products.

We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings.

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Technical Customer Success Manager - French Market (m/f/d) Your Role

As Technical Customer Success Manager for the French market, you are the primary point of contact for your customer cohort (of SMBs) once they've signed. You own their success, satisfaction, and retention end to end.

You actively build relationships, identify value drivers, and ensure every customer gets the most out of fonio. You'll spend most of your time in calls and meetings with customers and implementing or improving their setups.

 

What to expect

 * Own a portfolio of French SMB customers across their full lifecycle

 * Build relationships, surface value, and find new use cases for AI agents to keep customers engaged

 * Support customers in setting up their AI assistant; implement workflows for medium complex cases and coordinate with developers for advanced setups

 * Run check-ins and proactive calls based on usage signals (low engagement, expansion opportunities, setup friction)

 * Work with a ready-made pipeline and clear playbooks, with room to test your own initiatives

 * Maximize the value generated from each customer in your portfolio

 * Spot churn risks early and act on them

 * Manage your activity autonomously in HubSpot

 

Who We're Looking For

 * 2-5 years in Customer Success, Account Management, Forward Deployment Engineer or a technical client-facing SaaS/B2B role

 * Ideally a strong technical understanding - comfortable understanding API documentation and error logs to troubleshoot customer setup issues independently

 ** Experience with tools like n8n, make.com, codex or similar

 * An affinity for tech / AI products is a real plus

 * C2 French, strong English

 * Structured, autonomous, results-driven

 * You build trust easily with customers, by phone or video

 * You take initiative, test, iterate, and don't wait to be told what to do

 * Comfortable with CRM (ideally HubSpot) and data-driven workflows

 * Willing to relocate to Vienna for 1-2 months initially

 

What We Offer

 * €60,000-80,000 OTE

 * Equity: you help build it, you should own a piece of it

 * Equipment of your choice

 * A product that sells itself and that customers love (4.5 stars on Trustpilot, Google, and OMR)

 * Regular team offsites

 * Office in Vienna or Bracelona, onsite, in an ambitious team that wants to do the most exciting work of their careers

 

Hiring Process

 * 15 min intro call

 * 30 min skill interview

 * 30 min getting to know the country's Go-to-Market manager

 * 20 min culture call with our Founders

1 Master Thesis "Bi-Static Sensing of UAVs"  * Reliable detection and localisation of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) is becoming increasingly important for future civilian and commercial applications. This master's thesis focuses on the development and experimental validation of antenna arrays for bi-static sensing of UAVs using software-defined radio technology.
 * Under the guidance of our team, you will design, build, and characterise circularly polarised patch antennas for different array geometries for UAV sensing applications.
 * You will integrate the antenna arrays into an SDR-based testbed and perform experimental validation.
 * You will support us in developing simulation models for bi-static multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) sensing and realise a real-time measurement setup that can estimate azimuth, elevation and range.

 * You will gain hands-on experience with antenna design, beamforming, direction-of-arrival estimation, and software-defined radio systems.
 * You will learn how to validate the sensing algorithms using a state-of-the-art motion capture system.
 * You will work closely with researchers in wireless sensing and contribute to the development of next-generation UAV detection and localisation technologies.

Your qualifications:

 * You are pursuing a master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Physics, or a related field.
 * First experience (e.g. gained through university / student research projects, laboratory work, internships or similar activities) in at least one of the following areas: (i) Antenna array design and validation measurements or (ii) micro-Doppler-based bi-static sensing methods. In the cover letter, the candidate shall describe how their CV and personal interests for future development match at least one of the above profiles (explicitly referring to (i) or (ii)) and substantiate their claimed expertise. Please note that applications that do not address this point may not be considered further.

 * Programming experience in Python, MATLAB, or C++ for signal processing, beamforming, or bi-static sensing applications is beneficial.
 * You enjoy developing hardware prototypes and numerical algorithms, as well as performing experimental validation.
 * English language skills commensurate with the role

 * Duration of the master's thesis project: 6 months

 * Dedicated guidance and supervision from our experienced researchers, who will support you throughout your final thesis - from the initial concept to the final results.
